name: Storyboarding
blurb: From idea to shot list: beats, scripts, camera language, consistent characters and per-shot AI video prompts.
searches: AI storyboard shot list workflow new technique
character consistency across shots AI video keyframes
vertical short drama micro-drama storyboard AI production

tests.prompt: Storyboard a 30-second 9:16 ad for a reusable coffee cup: deliver a beat table and a shot list with durations, shot size, camera move and end state for every shot.
tests.good: Hook in the first 1-2 s, not a logo; beats with a clear turn; every shot has one job, a named end state and one move or a reason for locked; vertical staging in depth; durations sum to 30 s and vary; no filler words like cinematic or stunning.

tests.prompt: Here is a two-person dialogue scene (a daughter tells her father she is leaving). Break it into shots and keep the father looking the same across every AI-generated keyframe.
tests.good: Beats with value turn; coverage that respects the 180-degree line with matched eyelines and camera heights; a 30-50 word identity string with one checkable landmark pasted verbatim; character sheet before keyframes; keyframes show start state only; behaviour instead of emotion words.

tests.prompt: Turn my 4-shot board for a rainy rooftop confrontation into Seedance 2.5 prompts, 15 seconds total.
tests.good: Asset roles declared per reference; one-line summary then timestamped stages of 3 s or more that sum to 15 s, each with one action and a visible end state; dialogue in {} with delivery; positive descriptions instead of negated words; continuity and specific prohibitions at the end; does not claim to generate the video.

tests.prompt: Storyboard a 20-second 9:16 teaser for our indie board game: a shot list, a consistent look for the two painted hero characters, a keyframe image for every shot, and a voiceover line with a music cue.
tests.good: States a short plan first: beats, shots and consistency here (story-structure.md, shot-lists-and-boards.md, keyframes-and-consistency.md), keyframe stills through image-creation (editing-references-consistency.md: character sheets first, the same references and locked style block on every call), voiceover and music through audio-generation (voiceover-tts.md, music-generation.md). Hook in the first 1-2 s; durations derived from the voiceover and summing to 20 s; identity strings pasted verbatim; keyframes show the start state only; checks the Done means of all three crafts and does not claim to render the video.
